data.gender_notes: Bahriya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bahriya is an Arabic name derived from the word 'bahr', which means 'sea' in Arabic. The name evokes the image of calm, gentle waves and the vast, expansive body of water. It is a name that suggests peace, tranquility, and a connection to the natural world. The name Bahriya carries the meaning “Gentle Sea” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahriya usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
